h1:
Krabi Mookata–Grill Buffet
& Seafood Buffet: 10 Best Deals
intro: Krabi isn't just about the sea and the islands. Dinner here is fun because you get to pick: Thai-style mookata on a dome grill, a grill buffet loaded with Aussie beef, a steaming shabu hotpot, or a seafood buffet right by the water at Ao Nang with river prawns, black crab, and oysters you grill yourself. We picked 10 spots that are actually open and packed with Krabi locals, ranked from best value up to premium, and we tell you straight which one suits which kind of night out.

blocks.html: Krabi's grill buffets split into three lanes. The first is shabu and grill in Krabi town, mostly clustered around Maharat Soi 5 and Soi 15, easy to reach if you're staying in town. The second is Thai-style dome-grill mookata, the cheapest option and where locals meet up most often. The third, where Krabi beats most other towns, is the seafood buffet right on the water at Ao Nang, where you grill your own prawns, shellfish, and crab with a sea view. This list covers all three, ranked from best value up to premium.

blocks.text: 10 mookata, grill buffet & seafood spots Krabi locals actually go to

items.name: Laan Shabu–Yang Noey (Halal)
items.blurb: The best-value spot on the list. Shabu buffet starts around 249 THB per person, with drink refills around 39 THB, and there's no time limit. It's a halal restaurant near the Krabi Krin Hospital soi, great for travelers on a budget, big groups, or Muslim diners who find halal spots in town hard to come by.
items.meta: Soi by Krabi Krin Hospital · Krabi Town

items.name: SHABU KONG Krabi
items.blurb: A well-known shabu buffet in town with two main courses, roughly 279 and 399 THB net. You get a range of beef cuts, including chuck, brisket, and neck, plus salmon, mussels, and a choice of four broths including tom yum and a black soup. No time limit, and it's on Maharat Soi 5 near the center of town.

items.name: Jinzi Shabu
items.blurb: A shabu buffet that Krabi locals rate for ingredient quality. Three courses at roughly 299 / 459 / 699 THB; the top course comes with unlimited salmon sashimi and Thai-fish sashimi. The standout is the big prawns (20–25 per kilo) included in every course, plus Korean-style pickles and several broths. No time limit, on Maharat Soi 5 below Green Hotel.
items.meta: Maharat Road Soi 5 (below Green Hotel) · Krabi Town

items.name: Makan Shabu & Grill (Halal)
items.blurb: A halal shabu-and-grill buffet in town, with a course around 399 THB that includes unlimited drink refills. You get sliced beef, river prawns, sea prawns, salmon, scallops, and an unlimited salad bar. Open all afternoon and evening, from noon to 9pm, and a solid pick for Muslim families or anyone who wants both shabu and grill under one roof.

items.name: Yang Noey Krabi (Butter Grill)
items.blurb: A butter-grill buffet in town focused on Australian beef, seafood, and mookata all in one place. It's on Maharat Soi 15 next to Joke Miaolan, open from afternoon to 10pm, and from noon on weekends. Good for beef lovers who want that fragrant butter-grill flavor without the bill getting too heavy.

items.name: The Lion Grill & Shabu
items.blurb: A popular grill-and-shabu spot on Maharat Soi 15. The draw is the lively, neon-lit atmosphere and the beef in the higher course that reviewers praise. The top course is around 599 THB with a generous beef spread, soy-marinated salmon, and river prawns, ordered via QR at the table. Good for a group of friends who want the food and the vibe.

items.name: Raan Derm Mookata (Krabi Town branch)
items.blurb: Traditional Thai dome-grill mookata that Krabi locals come to regularly. The focus is marinated pork, blanched veg, noodles, and a punchy jaew dipping sauce. A hundred-something baht fills you up, an easy, wallet-friendly dinner you don't have to overthink. Good if you want a genuinely Thai mookata feel rather than a sliced-beef buffet.

items.name: Ta Lay Grilled Seafood Buffet (Nopparat Thara Beach)
items.blurb: A grilled seafood buffet right by the water around Nopparat Thara Beach and Ao Nang. The course runs about 399 THB, unlimited for roughly 3 hours, and you grill your own prawns, shellfish, and fish. The beachside setting is relaxed, ideal if you're staying around Ao Nang and want a seafood buffet without heading into town.

items.name: Long Lay Aonang Seafood
items.blurb: A grilled seafood buffet by the water at Ao Nang Landmark, around 489–499 THB, with grilled seafood, mookata, and dessert. You pick from river prawns, black crab, and oysters, drinks are included, there's no time limit, and there's live music in the evening. Open 4pm–11pm. Good for a chilled-out dinner by the sea with a bit of atmosphere.

items.name: Premium grilled seafood buffet (Ao Nang area)
items.blurb: The top end of the seafood lane: an upmarket grilled-seafood buffet around Ao Nang and the Landmark that lays out big river prawns, black crab, and oysters with no limit. Prices move up into the 500s and beyond, so it's better suited to a celebration dinner or the last night of a trip when you want to do seafood right. Check the latest promos and prices with the restaurant before you go.

blocks.title: How to pick the best-value spot
blocks.html: Check three things before you decide — whether drinks are included (many spots in town charge extra or about 39 THB per refill), whether there's a time limit (a lot of in-town shabu places have none, but some seafood buffets give you about 3 hours), and the food-waste fee that some seafood places add if you load up on prawns and shellfish and don't finish them. Take a little at a time and refill — that's how you get the best value.

blocks.text: Krabi town vs. Ao Nang by the sea: which area to pick

blocks.html: If you're staying in Krabi town, the shabu and grill spots are clustered around Maharat Soi 5 and Soi 15, an easy walk or short motorbike ride away. Prices start in the 200s–300s THB, they're good value, and many have no time limit. If you're staying around Ao Nang, go for a seafood buffet by the water like Long Lay or one of the spots near Nopparat Thara Beach for the beach atmosphere and seafood you grill yourself. Prices climb into the 400s–500s, but you get the view and a full spread of prawns, shellfish, and crab.

items: Tightest budget, a couple hundred baht — Laan Shabu–Yang Noey, Raan Derm Mookata; good for big groups or a tight budget
Shabu in town, no time limit — SHABU KONG, Jinzi Shabu; sit and chat as long as you like
Looking for halal — Laan Shabu–Yang Noey, Makan Shabu & Grill
Seafood by the sea / celebration meal — Long Lay Aonang, Ta Lay Grilled Seafood Buffet; good if you're staying in Ao Nang

blocks.title: Straight talk
blocks.html: The prices listed are ballpark figures. Krabi buffets change their courses and promos often, especially seafood spots where prices move with the cost of prawns, shellfish, and crab. Before you go, check the restaurant's page or call to confirm the latest rates. And plenty of in-town spots close in the afternoon and reopen in the evening, so check opening hours before you head out to be safe.

blocks.text: What to know before you go

items: Check opening hours — some in-town shabu spots open in the afternoon (weekdays from 2–3pm), while Ao Nang seafood places start in the evening, around 4pm.
Seafood buffets often have a time limit — some give you about 3 hours, whereas many in-town shabu spots have none.
Cash vs. card — some spots in town and by the sea prefer cash, so keep some on hand.
Food-waste fee — many seafood places charge extra if you take prawns and shellfish and don't finish them, so take a little at a time.
Long lines on weekends and in high season — popular Ao Nang spots get busy in the evening, so go early or call ahead to book.

faq.q: How much does a grill or shabu buffet in Krabi cost?
faq.a: Best-value shabu spots in town like Laan Shabu–Yang Noey start around 249 THB per person, SHABU KONG runs about 279–399 THB net, and Jinzi Shabu ranges from 299 up to a 699 THB top course. Seafood buffets by the water at Ao Nang move up into the 399–499 THB range. Most prices don't include drinks, which some spots charge around 39 THB per refill.

faq.q: Which seafood buffets are right by the sea at Ao Nang?
faq.a: Long Lay Aonang Seafood at Ao Nang Landmark is the one people talk about most, around 489–499 THB, with grilled seafood, mookata, river prawns, black crab, and oysters, drinks included and live music. Another is Ta Lay Grilled Seafood Buffet around Nopparat Thara Beach, about 399 THB with roughly a 3-hour limit.

faq.q: Are there halal buffets in Krabi?
faq.a: Yes. Laan Shabu–Yang Noey near the Krabi Krin Hospital soi is a halal shabu spot starting around 249 THB, and Makan Shabu & Grill in town is a halal shabu-and-grill buffet at about 399 THB including drinks. Both are good for Muslim families looking for a place in Krabi.

faq.q: Where are the shabu and grill spots in Krabi town?
faq.a: Most are clustered on Maharat Road. SHABU KONG and Jinzi Shabu are on Maharat Soi 5, while Yang Noey and The Lion Grill & Shabu are on Maharat Soi 15. They're all in Krabi town and easy to reach if you're staying around the center.

faq.q: Do you need to book ahead for a buffet in Krabi?
faq.a: On weekdays there are usually free tables, but on weekend evenings and in high season the popular spots, especially seafood places at Ao Nang, get busy. Go early in the evening or call ahead to book, and check opening hours first since some in-town shabu spots only open in the afternoon and evening.
